Are you kidding me? They blew out the bridge! Great, we have to find another way onto the tracks.
These zombies have been following us for miles! Shouldn't they have wandered off by now?
Maybe it has something to do with whatever Dispatcher was trying to say. Right now we need to stop the rest of the horde from catching up to us.
Over here! Someone made a bridge onto the tracks! I'm just worried the tunnel is full of zombies.
Alright. Alright. I have an idea.
How much do you care about this bridge?
I'll grab some explosives off the truck and prepare the bridge. Once I set the timer we'll jump onto the tracks before it hits zero.
Sniper and I can cover him, Commander. It'll give you, the Recruit, and Soldier enough time to get the survivors off the bridge.

Sounds good. Sniper. Cover us from behind. Soldier. Hold this position with Hops. Minigunner will lead everyone into the tunnels, and I'll set the tracker on the APC. A helicopter will pick it up along with the other survivors.
We've got explosives version of Pyro. He'll make it happen.
How crazy do you think I am?
I'm seeing a lot of movement!
Everyone off the bridge! Go! Go! Go! — I need an update!
Explosives are set! He's arming the charge now!
Who built this timer? I have to rewire the whole thing!
Well you better be quick because they're getting close! When it blows, every zombie for miles will hear it.
Almost everyone is in the tunnels! I need you guys over here, NOW!
It's too far to shoot. I might hit Demo and Hops! I'm moving up to cover them!
